## Download and use this snapshot

This page describes the published files in `nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-gap-index`. Treat them as a dated snapshot: use the observation dates and limitations in the files and source notes below. A page edit does not refresh the measurements.

With the Kaggle CLI installed and authenticated:

```bash
kaggle datasets download -d nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-gap-index -p ./dataset --unzip
```

Start by inspecting `current.json`. Keep its original bytes and record the Kaggle version before transforming or comparing results.

Published files include:

- `README.md`
- `eval.yaml`
- `current.json`
- `manifest.jsonl`
- `weeks/2026-W35.json`
- `weeks/2026-W36.json`

[Current GSPC board](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc) · [Methodology](https://councilof.ai/methodology/) · [Verify supported signed records](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/) · [Corrections](https://councilof.ai/claim-maintenance)

Apply the licence shown on this dataset. Published by Council of AI — Council for the Safety of Artificial Intelligence, operated by CSOAI Ltd. Measurement is not certification; a mirror or package is not evidence of current board admission or benchmark leadership.

---

> **Mirror.** This is a copy of https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/gspc-gap-index at revision `eb6cbfdfa9651a868336ca2a8a373dac99a48d1b`, made 2026-10-06. The Hugging Face copy is the original; if the two differ, it wins.

# GSPC gap index

Live board: GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc — quote `totals.public_count` and `totals.lid` only. Not certification.

Weekly tape of material claims with **no stranger-recomputable row**.

`current.json` tracks the live board. When `unmeasured_axes` is empty, the board has no declared hollow axis slots — the tape still records other hollow claims (stamps, indexes) without inventing scores.

This is not a ranking, not a rating, not a certification.

Files:

- `current.json` — latest week (live)
- `weeks/YYYY-Www.json` — dated snapshots

**UNMEASURED catalog when the board has empties.** Empty stays empty. Not a certificate.

## What is in this repository

| file | bytes | rows | what |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `weeks/2026-W35.json` | 3469 |  | JSON document |
| `current.json` | 1741 |  | JSON document |
| `weeks/2026-W36.json` | 1741 |  | JSON document |
| `README.md` | 1363 |  | card |
| `eval.yaml` | 510 |  | config |
| `manifest.jsonl` | | 6 | derived at 2026-09-04T04:33:29Z |

`manifest.jsonl` is derived from this repository's own file tree at 2026-09-04T04:33:29Z; it lists every file with its
size, its blob hash and a direct URL, so an agent can enumerate the repo without cloning it.
